summary: Sandbach United got their 2026/27 season off to a winning start with a hard-fought 1-0 victory over Stafford Town, with Stan Tatters grabbing the decisive goal in the first half. The Bach delivered a battling performance to secure all three points and a clean sheet on opening day, setting a positive tone for the campaign ahead. Paul Calibre continues his backing of the squad, having now sponsored multiple players including match-winner Tatters.
